name: _PyBytes_FormatEx
reason: formatLoop and formatSpec mirror :628-1158, and theorems now run formatSpec end to end. FormatBytesArgs covers %b, %s, the * precision and the * width. name: bytes_decode_impl

name: bytes_fromhex_impl
